review.posthog_relevance: Adds histogram percentile aggregation support and compatibility checks to the metrics viewer and anomaly detection requests.
review.reason: The change implements histogram percentile support (p50, p95, p99) across the frontend options, backend aggregation types, and compatibility guards. This is a substantive, bounded capability improvement: it extends the metrics viewer and anomaly detection workflows with histogram-specific aggregation and conversion, while adding compatibility checks and defaults.
